# image

Raster-to-vector tracing with ImageMagick and potrace.

---

## `image_trace_to_svg`

Trace a raster image to a vector SVG. The image is flattened onto a white background, converted to PNM, then traced by potrace. Output defaults to <input>.svg beside the input.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Overwrites <output.svg> when it already exists — prompts first.

**Usage**

```sh
image_trace_to_svg <input-image> [output.svg]
```

**Examples**

```sh
image_trace_to_svg logo.png
image_trace_to_svg scan.jpg ~/Desktop/scan.svg
```

**Requires** `magick`, `potrace`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/image.sh:15`](../../modules/common/image.sh#L15)
